similarityReview: The 3D model accurately reconstructs the Cleveland State University (CSU) complex, featuring the prominent brutalist/modernist high-rise tower in the background and the multi-story glass-facade academic annex in the foreground. The tower's vertical concrete ribbing, recessed top mechanical floor, and green 'CSU' signage are represented. The foreground annex is modeled with its large multi-story glass curtain wall (using glassHex), concrete structural frame, and entrance canopy. The back and side walls are fully enclosed to prevent hollow gaps, and the roof slopes are correctly oriented outward.
